livingCosts.notes: UCL publishes no itemised general cost-of-living estimate we could read (only 'around £20,000' a year for graduate study). This is UCL's itemised 2025-26 Cost of Attendance budget (maximum amounts for US federal loans), weekly figures x 39 weeks / 9 months (undergraduate year): housing = midpoint of on-campus £309 and off-campus £257/week; food £94/week; transportation £45/week; personal = personal £60 + course materials £22 + computing supplies £11 per week. Flights, visa and health surcharge excluded. www.ucl.ac.uk blocks automated access; read from the Wayback Machine copy dated 2026-05-16, so marked secondary.
